% thematic fixture (c, OPTIONAL) — \settabs/\+ with math.
% Pins the tabbing alignment leg with inline $...$ math in the fields:
% \settabs sets column stops, each \+ line lays fields against them, and the
% fields here carry inline math.  \settabs/\+ rely on the deferred-close
% \hbox\bgroup open-group box construction (the known-weakest area /
% [[project-open-group-box-gap]]), so a divergence here is EXPECTED and is
% characterized (README + follow-up) rather than fixed here.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\settabs 2 \columns
\+$a+b$&$x=y$\cr
\+$c-d$&$\alpha\beta$\cr
\+$e+f$&$z=w$\cr
\bye
